basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school student from Ohio, just getting the hang of Reddit. I'm into running and recently started the Couch to 5K program, which is why I'm active in the C25K subreddit. Outside of running, I'm interested in learning more about different cultures, hence my recent interest in the Senegal subreddit. I'm a bit of a night owl, so you might catch me online late at night. Currently single, and focusing on my studies and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a high school student, my knowledge is mostly academic, with a strong focus on physical education and geography. I've picked up a lot of my running knowledge through online resources and community advice on subreddits like C25K.
